newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cenbank sets 5-yr state bond auction Aug 5.
newsitem.headline: Czech cenbank sets 5-yr state bond auction Aug 5.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Tuesday that the next auction of government bonds would offer five billion crowns in five-year bonds on August 5.
The coupon on the issue will be determined at auction which has a deadline for bids at noon local time (1000 gmt) on August 4. A maximum acceptable yield on bids has yet to be determined.

The last state bond auction was on May 2 when a tranche of five billion crowns in two-year bonds was oversubscribed with bids totalling 5.68 billion crowns and an average gross yield on accepted bids of 11.12 percent.
Czech interest rates have risen since then especially after the central bank's moves to defend the Czech crown against speculative attacks in late May.
